import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source tables
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/training_3.csv"
]

# Corresponding years for each source file, based on the target schema and source examples
# Source 0 -> 2013
# Source 1 -> 2014
# Source 2 -> 2015
# Source 3 -> 2016
years = [2013, 2014, 2015, 2016]

# Read all source files into dataframes with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(fp, index_col=0) for fp in source_files]

# Each source has schema: ['Wrestler', 'Wins', 'Losses', 'Draws']
# Target schema has columns for each year: 'YYYY Wins', 'YYYY Losses', 'YYYY Draws'
# We need to rename the columns Wins, Losses, Draws in each source df to the corresponding year columns

renamed_dfs = []
for df, year in zip(dfs, years):
    # Rename columns Wins, Losses, Draws to e.g. '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws'
    df_renamed = df.rename(columns={
        'Wins': f'{year} Wins',
        'Losses': f'{year} Losses',
        'Draws': f'{year} Draws'
    })
    renamed_dfs.append(df_renamed)

# Now we have 4 dataframes with columns:
# ['Wrestler', '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws'] (for example for year=2013)
# We want to join them all on 'Wrestler' to get a single dataframe with all years' stats as columns

# Start with the first dataframe
df_merged = renamed_dfs[0]

# Iteratively merge on 'Wrestler' using outer join to keep all wrestlers from all years
for df in renamed_dfs[1:]:
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_merged, df, on='Wrestler', how='outer')

# After merging, some wrestlers may have NaN for some years if they didn't appear in that source
# Fill NaN with 0 for all numeric columns (wins, losses, draws)
numeric_cols = [col for col in df_merged.columns if col != 'Wrestler']
df_merged[numeric_cols] = df_merged[numeric_cols].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Wrestler',
    '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws',
    '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
    '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws',
    '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws'
]

df_final = df_merged[target_columns]

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file without the index
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_final.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/training_0.csv', index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/training_1.csv', index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/training_2.csv', index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/training_3.csv', index_col=0)

# Rename columns to match target year-specific columns
df0 = df0.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2013 Wins',
    'Losses': '2013 Losses',
    'Draws': '2013 Draws'
})

df1 = df1.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2014 Wins',
    'Losses': '2014 Losses',
    'Draws': '2014 Draws'
})

df2 = df2.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2015 Wins',
    'Losses': '2015 Losses',
    'Draws': '2015 Draws'
})

df3 = df3.rename(columns={
    'Wins': '2016 Wins',
    'Losses': '2016 Losses',
    'Draws': '2016 Draws'
})

# Join all tables on 'Wrestler' column
df01 = pd.merge(df0, df1, on='Wrestler', how='inner')
df012 = pd.merge(df01, df2, on='Wrestler', how='inner')
df0123 = pd.merge(df012, df3, on='Wrestler', how='inner')

# Group by Wrestler and sum all numeric columns (in case of duplicates)
result = df0123.groupby('Wrestler', as_index=False).sum()

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = ['Wrestler',
                  '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws',
                  '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
                  '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws',
                  '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws']

result = result[target_columns]

# Write output CSV
result.to_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_8/target_multisource_critique_history.csv', index=False)
